thread:
Ravi (PM): FYI competitors launched a "budget inference" pitch today. link: https://example.com/budget-infer. They're bundling cheap quant models + self-serve routing.
Leah (Eng): saw it. tech looks like disabled KV cache + aggressive quant. probably lower quality but cheaper.
Sam (Fin): if we respond with a blunt price cut we'll blow margin. need a non-price play or a narrowly scoped economy tier.
Nia (Design): marketing messaging is already leaning into "developer experiments". we can mirror but emphasize safety/controls.
Ravi (PM): options on the table:
- economy tier (limited guarantees)
- match price temporarily (promo)
- highlight reliability and rollout features (own the reliability story)
Leah (Eng): Build estimate for economy tier: 3w for core + canary plumbing. Key constraints: read-only prefix cache, per-tenant QPS cap, and explicit no-route-SLOs text.
Sam (Fin): modeling note: economy price = ~40% off standard. at that discount breakpoint, payback needs >2x volume to be neutral. unlikely short-term.
Nia (Design): suggested microcopy: "Economy tier — lower cost, best-effort latency, included safety controls". also add a toggle in Console: "Pause economy for tenant".
Ravi (PM): mandatory launch guardrails proposal:
- Metric guardrails: P95 tail latency < 800ms on average during canary
- Quality guardrails: automated sampling of 500 prompts / day with annotated QA; fail if >3% unacceptable responses
- Rollout: 3-stage canary: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 2 weeks
Leah (Eng): rollout API example:
```
rollout.create(feature="economy_routing", tenant=1234, stages=[{"pct":0.01,"duration":"48h"},{"pct":0.10,"duration":"7d"},{"pct":0.50,"duration":"7d"}])
```
metrics-bot: alert configured: economy_routing.experiment -> paging if error_rate > 0.8% or avg_quality_drop > 2%.
Sam (Fin): we'll accept a small pilot if engineering limits downside risk and telemetry isolates economy traffic. Also need an expiration for promo pricing if we try that.
Nia (Design): UI: show an inline tooltip: "Economy traffic is routed to lower-cost variants. No throughput SLA."
Ravi (PM): decision: proceed with economy tier MVP + strong comms on reliability. No price-match across the board. We keep pricing intact but offer a time-boxed promo for new tenants only.
Leah (Eng): I'll spin up a spike for the prefix-only cache and experiment tagging. ETA: prototype by EOD Friday.
Sam (Fin): I'll draft the promo window language and margins impact for leadership.
Nia (Design): I'll drop a hero variant + tooltip copy in #design-review in 3 hours.
Ravi (PM): action items:
- Leah: prototype + canary pipeline (track experiment=economy-q4)
- Sam: promo terms + finance model
- Nia: microcopy + console toggle mock
- Ravi: one-pager and go/no-go by next Wed
metrics-bot: scheduled report: economy_routing.daily-summary -> next run 2024-02-02T09:00Z
Ravi (PM): thanks team. keep comms tight — we don't want to start a price war. :handshake:
